verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST API for creating and managing Cloud resources, including launching and restarting instances. It also supports cloud-init for launch-time configuration, and a runtime probe confirms the OpenAPI-specified API is live and key-gated, so instances can be provisioned and configured headlessly from automation or CI. Managed Slurm adds non-interactive batch job scheduling. missing for 10: an official first-party CLI (the only CLI is an unofficial community tool), documented CI-pipeline integrations or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
You can also restart instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
If you're launching your instance with the Lambda Cloud API, you can add launch-time configuration instructions using cloud-init
the instance-provisioning REST API is live and key-gated
